months.note: 2000년 5월 어청도와 상왕등도 인근 해상에서 성조 3마리가 확인되었다.

summary: 주로 숲 가장자리에서 발견되는 작은 새로, 우리나라에서는 함경북도에서 번식한다. 2000년 5월 전라북도 서해안의 어청도와 상왕등도 인근 바다에서 다 자란 새 3마리가 확인된 기록이 있다. 부리 길이는 10.7~11.5mm, 날개 길이는 52.0~54.5mm, 꽁지 길이는 42.5~45.5mm, 부척은 18.6~19.4mm이다.

art.subject: Baikal Bush Warbler (Locustella davidi), adult in spring (May): upperparts uniform dark olive-brown without any streaks; narrow greyish-white supercilium; grey-brown ear-coverts; throat whitish with a variable band of small dark spots across the lower throat and upper breast; breast and flanks washed grey-brown, centre of the belly whitish; long undertail coverts brown with broad whitish tips that look scaly; tail plain dark brown. Bill fine and dark; dark eye; legs pinkish.
art.pose: perched low in shrubs at a forest edge, side view
art.scene: Korean forest edge with dense low shrubs; no people, buildings or text
art.build: Tiny, skulking bush warbler, 108–113 mm long, smaller than a sparrow. Round-bodied with a short neck, rounded head and short, rounded wings; at rest the wingtips barely pass the base of the tail. Bill thin, pointed and straight, shorter than the head. Legs fairly long and pinkish, with strong feet for gripping stems. Tail medium length, broad and rounded at the tip, with long undertail coverts reaching far along its underside. Creeps low in dense shrubs and rarely flies far.
avoid: Do not streak the back or crown; the upperparts are plain, unlike Lanceolated Warbler (Locustella lanceolata).
Do not add wing-bars, a bold white supercilium or yellow tones; the bird is dull brown and grey.
Do not paint a long notched tail; the tail is broad and rounded.
Do not paint dark legs; they are pinkish.
